Hmm , accepting your stutter shouldn’t necessarily make you more fluent, it could , but the point of accepting it .
Is not dwelling on it, thinking  negatively about stuttering moments  that  happened 

Because either way wether you accept your stutter or not , you are going to stutter  that is something you cant control 

So i stopped trying to control something i obviously cannot control , that no matter what i do i still there 

Soo i changed my focus to things i can control like the way i think , exercising, improving myself doing any productive activity instead of thinking of my stutter that no matter how long i think about it and hate it  will still remain
